import re

def parse(lines):
    rows = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    f = ''
    s = ''
    p = ''
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\S.*\ssyntax OK\s*$', l) or re.match(r'^\S.*\shad compilation errors', l):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^File\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            f = m.group('v'); s = ''; p = ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+Subroutine\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            s = m.group('v'); p = ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+Package\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            p = m.group('v')
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+(?P<sym>\S+)\s+(?P<refs>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            rows.append({'File': f, 'Subroutine': s, 'Package': p, 'Symbol': m.group('sym'), 'Lines': m.group('refs')})
            used.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'symbols', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
